method: Inspect all registered same-species sources, explicitly exclude incompatible actions/identity, then one shared direct nearest/binary-alpha/common-palette export per eligible source cohort. Optional single shared transparent-margin crop across all cohort frames, with exact zero-pixel discard proof and origin/pivot conversion; never per-frame fitting.
lookDefinition: Recognizable head/bill attention change at normal scale with coherent identity and stationary stance; upward, downward or viewer-oriented attention may qualify without claiming a new generated pose. Gait/bob/translation alone and required object-contact poses do not qualify.
gates: Exact registered IDs, source PNGs, historical prompts/originals, prior issues preserved.
Normal-size visible semantic pose and coherent identity/scale/feet, independently reviewed.
Unchanged shared actual pixel-normalizer and actual canonicalJSON; exact rejection recorded if limits fail.
Source usefulness, full runtime admission and live scene acceptance remain distinct.
No blink clip is manufactured from awake/look if no closed-eye source exists.
New drawing required versus support/packaging decision is explicitly classified; no useful slot claim from completed paperwork.
nextAfterBatch: Rank specific drawing needs and support decisions; no generation starts in this batch.
